How a stocktake works

Three short steps — tap a location below when you are ready.

  1. 1. Choose where you are counting

    Tap a location in the list. Favourites appear first. Search if you have many warehouses or vans.

  2. 2. Count what is on the shelf

    The next screen lists every active item at that location. Type the real quantity; each line autosaves.

  3. 3. Close when you are finished

    Closing posts stock adjustments so the system matches the shelf. You can leave uncounted lines unchanged if you confirm.
